text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't want to.
If things stay like this, everyone will forget about me."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No...
I wonder if everyone has already forgotten.
Forgotten about Chan-Ma.
choice_data_list: I'll always keep capturing you on screen.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that is true.
Your eyes are my very own exclusive lens.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I feel a bit better now.
choice_data_list: Let's take it slow and do our best from here on out

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. Machan will do her best, without rushing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I hope Trainer-san's lens
will capture a smiling Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. If the current Curren-chan wins,
it's bound to make everyone's hearts rumble with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This is a big chance to take a massive leap towards becoming the Ultra Super Mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"We need to increase production
of the Mar-chan Dolls...!"
